name: Spirit Box: A Midnight Seance
source:
You balance quirky clients, questionable seances, and the pressure of earning enough coins to safely guide spirits to the afterlife. But beware, push your luck too far, and you might expose yourself as a fraud or, worse, let the spirits possess you.

Can you survive the night and pay your ghostly debts, or will the afterlife come for you?

[From [url=https://artofnixbee.itch.io/spirit-box]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你需要平衡古怪的客户、可疑的降神会和赚取足够金币以安全引导灵魂进入来世的压力。但要小心，如果你的运气太过了，你可能会暴露自己是一个骗子，或者更糟糕的是，让鬼魂附身。

你能熬过这一夜并偿还你幽灵般的债务吗？或者来世会来找你吗？

[来自[url=https://artofnixbee.itch.io/spirit-box]Itch.io[/url]]
